demos.name: BasicExampleDataGrid
demos.description: Sorting is enabled by default to the Data Grid users and works out of the box without any explicit configuration.

demos.name: BasicExampleDataGridPro
demos.description: By default, users need to hold down the Ctrl or Shift (use ⌘ Command on macOS) key while clicking the column header.

demos.name: MultiSortingWithoutModifier
demos.description: You can also enable multi-sorting without modifier keys by setting the multipleColumnsSortingMode prop to "always".

demos.name: InitialSort
demos.section: Pass sorting rules to the Data Grid › Initialize the sort model
demos.description: Sorting is enabled by default to the user.

demos.name: ControlledSort
demos.section: Pass sorting rules to the Data Grid › Controlled sort model
demos.description: You can use the onSortModelChange prop to listen to changes in the sorting rules and update the prop accordingly.

demos.name: DisableSortingGridAllColumns
demos.section: Disable the sorting › For all columns
demos.description: Sorting is enabled by default, but you can easily disable this feature by setting the disableColumnSorting prop.

demos.name: DisableSortingGrid
demos.section: Disable the sorting › For some columns
demos.description: By default, all columns are sortable.

demos.name: ReadOnlySortingGrid
demos.section: Disable the sorting › Sorting non-sortable columns programmatically
demos.description: In the following demo, the firstName column is not sortable by the default grid UI, but it is sorted programmatically by a custom built UI.

demos.name: FullyCustomSortComparator
demos.section: Custom comparator › Create a comparator from scratch
demos.description: In the following demo, the "Created on" column sorting is based on the day of the month of the createdOn field.

demos.name: ExtendedSortComparator
demos.description: In the following demo, the "Name" column combines the name and isAdmin fields.

demos.name: OrderSortingGrid
demos.section: Custom sort order › For all columns
demos.description: The default sort order can be overridden for all columns with the sortingOrder prop.

demos.name: OrderSortingPerColumnGrid
demos.description: Sort order can be configured (and overridden) on a per-column basis by setting the sortingOrder property of the GridColDef interface:

demos.name: ServerSortingGrid
demos.description: Sorting can be run server-side by setting the sortingMode prop to server, and implementing the onSortModelChange handler.

demos.name: SortingApiNoSnap
demos.description: Only use this API as the last option.
